items.title: The Agent Access Model
items.summary: For the last twelve years, enterprise security has moved away from trusting the network. BeyondCorp made the case that a request's origin, inside the corporate perimeter or on the open Internet, should not decide whether it is allowed. Identity and device health should. That model won: it now underpins much of Zero Trust. Google’s BeyondCorp assumed a specific principal: a human at a device, acting at human speed. Or
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了AI Agent在企业环境中的安全挑战，并提出了“Agent访问模型”（AAM）。随着Agent从简单的任务执行转向复杂的系统交互，传统的基于人类身份的访问控制已不再适用。AAM的核心理念是通过缩小Agent的权限范围，实现更精细化的访问控制，从而降低安全风险。该模型为构建安全、可控的Agent协作环境提供了理论框架，对于企业级AI落地具有重要的指导意义。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出了针对AI Agent的访问控制模型（AAM），解决了当前Agent在企业环境中权限过大和安全管控缺失的痛点。
